title: Austin: State Law, Local Code Adjustments
summary:
*   A public hearing was held to discuss proposed updates to Austin's local laws.
*   These changes aimed to align the City Code with the repeal of specific sections of the Texas Government Code (S.B. 1704).
*   Following the discussion, no immediate action or new policy was decided upon at this meeting.
